exact_question: For the frozen hillipop-ede_n3 configuration and each fixed admitted common background on 0 <= z <= 810, do the exact source-real low-redshift hydrogen/temperature branch-selection rules admit an absolutely continuous continuation to z=0 from every state in the validated z=810 domain, separately for q=xHeII=10^-6 and q=0, without changing or convexifying the selector?

time_variable.orientation: future direction; z decreases from 810 to 0

peebles_ratio_exact_tangent.certificate: v_uu < -1/10 on the material tangent strip for both q branches

pion_hmla_swift.literal_local_lemma: L_HMLA F<0 OR L_SWIFT F>0 implies local literal-selector Caratheodory existence

threshold_separation.consequence: No unresolved simultaneous PEEBLES-ratio/Pion state-interface corner occurs.

GLOBAL_1_AWAY_FROM_INTERFACE.reason: On the invariant safe tube each active PEEBLES/HMLA/SWIFT field is finite and locally Lipschitz in state away from state selectors. Atomic/SWIFT interpolation is finite piecewise cubic on in-range coordinates; H>0 and nH>0; SWIFT 1+DK has inherited positive lower bounds; generalized C-factor denominators are positive; thermal denominator 1+fHe+x_reio is positive.

GLOBAL_2_ALL_LOCAL_GATES.reason: Classical branch IVPs cover ordinary points; the existing Pion self-side disjunction plus literal-selector lemma covers Pion interface points; non-tangent PEEBLES ratio points have a common nonzero normal; exact tangency is covered by the strict PEEBLES v_uu<-1/10 certificate. Fixed-time selector/lookup transitions are concatenated because an isolated time value is measure-zero in the Caratheodory equation.

GLOBAL_3_INVARIANT_CONTINUATION.reason: The inherited branchwise hydrogen inward barriers and moving thermal barriers are used only as a-priori estimates on each already-existing local segment. They imply 0<=h<=Hstar<1 for a branch-uniform Hstar depending on the fixed background/domain, and 0.98*exp(-t)<=v<=1.000001. Hence the solution remains in a compact source-defined safe tube and cannot terminate by state blow-up or source-domain loss.

GLOBAL_4_ZENO_ACCUMULATION.reason: The finitely many source branch fields are uniformly bounded on the safe tube by some finite M. Therefore every literal solution is M-Lipschitz. If switching times accumulate at tau<T, the state is Cauchy and has a limit y(tau-). That limiting state remains admissible/source-defined; the already-proved local existence result restarts the literal solution at tau, contradicting maximality. Thus Zeno accumulation cannot be a finite-time existence obstruction.

GLOBAL_5_REIONIZATION_FIXED_TIME.reason: Hydrogen recombination continues to use x_noreio=h+q. The frozen reio_camb map used by the temperature equation is bounded and affine in xe_before=h+q with tanh time dependence below the fixed reionization start; above it x_reio=x_noreio. Its fixed-time switch may cause at most a bounded time discontinuity and preserves Caratheodory measurability/local state-Lipschitzness. Moreover reionization begins below the TR_MIN forced-PEEBLES threshold, so it does not create a new simultaneous hydrogen state-selector corner.

maximal_extension_theorem.statement: For each fixed admitted common background and each q in {10^-6,0}, every state in the validated z=810 domain admits at least one absolutely continuous Caratheodory continuation of the exact literal source selector through the full interval to z=0.
proof_skeleton: Local existence holds at every admissible point of the safe tube, including all material state interfaces and fixed-time transitions.
Take a maximal forward literal-selector solution from the given start (equivalently extend by the usual maximal-extension construction).
A-priori barriers keep every local segment inside a compact source-defined tube and all active fields are uniformly bounded there.
If the maximal endpoint tau* were less than T=ln811, uniform boundedness makes the solution Lipschitz and gives an endpoint limit y*.
The endpoint y* is admissible; local existence at (tau*,y*) extends the solution, contradicting maximality.
Therefore the maximal endpoint is T, and the endpoint value at T gives an AC continuation to z=0.

claim_firewall: Existence only; uniqueness is not claimed.
The common background is fixed and admitted by hypothesis; its existence is not proved here.
No cosmological reachability requirement is imposed on theorem-domain starting states.
No native/P6 trajectory identity is claimed.
No selector smoothing, convexification, Filippov replacement or equality-rule change is used.
No empirical confirmation/falsification of the cosmological model follows.
